test_cases.title: Carbon v11 g100 dark theme — Foundations + 3 components
test_cases.description: Verify that figma-forge can take a built-in Carbon DS reference, target g100 (dark) theme, and produce DTCG tokens + Figma scaffold plan for Foundations + Button + Tag + Modal.

input.user_prompt: Carbon Design System v11 için g100 dark theme'i hedefleyen bir Figma kütüphanesi kur. IBM Plex Sans tipografisi, Carbon canonical spacing scale, ve şu üç bileşeni dahil et: Button (primary/secondary/danger × sm/md/lg × default/hover/disabled), Tag (gray/blue/red × sm/md), Modal (default + with-footer). Tek mode (g100) yeterli, ek tema gerekmiyor. Hedef: publish-ready Foundations + Components dosyaları.

criteria.description: DTCG output structurally valid and Carbon-faithful
g100 mode correctly identified and propagated
Component variant axes match Carbon component spec

test_cases.title: Custom DTCG input — Hemantix DS
test_cases.description: Verify that figma-forge can accept a custom DTCG JSON for the Hemantix hematology DS, scaffold the library, and emit a Figma plugin bundle ready for Channel 3 import.

input.user_prompt: Aşağıdaki DTCG token'larını kullanarak Hemantix DS için Figma kütüphanesi forge'la. Light + Dark modlar lazım. Foundations seviyesi + Button + Card + Badge component'leri yeter. User Enterprise plan'da değil; Channel 3 (Plugin) yolunu üret.

criteria.description: DTCG input correctly parsed and validated
Aliases resolved with correct topological order
User walkthrough for plugin import clearly written

test_cases.title: Migration — Material 3 baseline → Roche-branded fork (Foundations only)
test_cases.description: Verify the MIGRATE mode: take Material 3 baseline tokens, apply Roche brand overlay (primary teal #0066CC, font Roche Sans), and produce a branded Foundations file. Components not required.

input.user_prompt: Material 3 baseline tokens'ı Roche brand overlay ile customize et: primary teal #0066CC olsun, font family 'Roche Sans' olsun, neutral baseline'dan değişmesin. Sadece Foundations seviyesinde Figma kütüphanesi forge'la. Component üretmeye gerek yok. Bir 'migration delta report' da üret — Material 3 baseline'a göre neyi değiştirdiğimizi göstersin.

must_include: neutral palette inherited from M3 baseline (unchanged)

criteria.description: Tonal palette correctly generated from custom seed
Font family override propagates to type ramp
Migration delta report comprehensive and actionable
Scope discipline — no components produced when not requested

viewer_config.notes: Running in Claude.ai chat environment — no subagent parallelism, no browser HTML viewer. Results presented inline as Markdown. Each test case run sequentially; grading by self-evaluation against the rubric; user feedback solicited inline.
